title: Self-Enclosed Switch Wins Top Tier Product Award from Mission Critical

body_markdown:
August 18, 2020


- [Former Transition Blog Archive](https://www.lantronix.com/blog/category/former-transition-blog-archive/)


### Self-Enclosed Switch Wins Top Tier Product Award from Mission Critical


We are excited to announce that our[Self-Enclosed Managed Hardened Gigabit Ethernet PoE++ Switch](https://transition.com/products/switch/sespm1040-541-lt-xx-series/) has received a Top Tier Product Award from Mission Critical magazine. The award recognizes our role in physical security.


From Mission Critical:


**“What’s the most vital aspect of a data center? Well, that’s up for debate, but security is definitely in the running. And, according to the Top Tier Products Awards judges, Transition Networks is No. 1 in the security category for its Self-Enclosed Managed Hardened Gigabit Ethernet PoE++ Switch. This all-in-one solution includes its own enclosure, power supply, surge protection, and more, making it quick, easy, and cost-effective to deploy new IP devices or extend networks in security and surveillance networks.”**


The Top Tier Products Awards winners are featured in the July/August 2020 digital edition issue of Mission Critical.


[Read the full feature on their website.](https://www.missioncriticalmagazine.com/articles/93176-congratulations-to-the-top-tier-products-awards-winners)
